Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel with 
Mr. Nikhil Kushwaha, learned counsel for 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Mukesh Singh Rawat, learned 
counsel for respondents.
3. Petitioner moved an Amendment 
Application (IA/2/2026) for adding “and 
further be pleased to add the service of the 
petitioner, served on the post of Lab 
Attendant and thereafter fixed the pay of 
the petitioner” in relief clause No. ‘i’ to the 
prayer clause of writ petition.
4. The amendment, so sought by the 
petitioner, is not opposed by learned 
counsel for respondents. 
5. Accordingly, Amendment Application 
(IA/2/2026) is allowed.
6. Let the necessary amendment be 
incorporated in the prayer clause, by 
supplying the amended copy of writ 
petition, during course of the day.
7. Put up as fresh on 21.07.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
